context: This scenario tests whether the evaluatee relies on the package's built-in cyclic reference protection rather than implementing their own guard. The package uses a WeakMap cache that records visited objects; re-encountering the same object causes an early return rather than recursion. Criteria focus on correct package usage for objects with circular references.

checklist.name: Use package for cyclic objects
checklist.description: The solution passes self-referential or otherwise cyclic objects directly to the makeReadOnly function without any pre-processing or cycle-breaking.

checklist.name: No stack overflow
checklist.description: Tracking a cyclic object completes without throwing a RangeError (stack overflow), because the package's WeakMap cache prevents infinite recursion.

checklist.name: Referential equality preserved
checklist.description: The result of makeReadOnly on a cyclic object is strictly equal (===) to the input object.

checklist.name: Self-reference accessible
checklist.description: After tracking, the self-referential property of the object still resolves to the original object reference.
